title: ADP Workforce Now pricing - $10-$30/employee/month plus base platform and add-on fees
clean_text: ADP Workforce Now uses quotation-based pricing tailored to company size and selected features. Reported per-employee monthly rates run roughly $10 (Essential), $17 (Enhanced), and $25 (Complete), while the Plus plan base platform has been cited at $23-$30/employee/month. On top of the per-employee rate, a base platform fee of $1,500-$5,000/year applies plus implementation fees of $2,000-$10,000+. Add-ons stack further: HR Assist costs $5-$8/employee/month, Enhanced Insights analytics costs $3-$6/employee/month, and the recruiting add-on costs $3/employee/month plus a $2,000 one-time setup fee.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-employee plus custom quote
